app.name: APAR 3D Trainer
app.title: Interactive 3D Fire Extinguisher Trainer & Configurator
app.tagline: Configure it. Learn PASS. Prove it.
lang.label: Language
splash.error: Couldn't load the 3D model. Check your connection and try again.
nav.label: Main navigation
hotspot.hint: Select a numbered marker or a part of the extinguisher to read about it. Rotate the view to find parts on the other side.
hotspot.viewer: 3D fire extinguisher. Drag to rotate and scroll or pinch to zoom.
config.loading: Configuration controls will be available when the 3D model is ready.
config.colorUnavailable: Body color and the agent strip/label are unavailable for this model. Capacity, bracket, specifications and price still work.
config.illustrativeNote: Illustrative specifications and visual codes, not a real product catalog or certified ratings. All agents share the same model, nozzle and gauge; part details describe the base ABC model. Capacities use kg throughout this demo. Weight excludes the bracket.
spec.source: Fire class reference: Banda Aceh Fire Department
training.introNote: Practice four steps with the demo ABC extinguisher. You can skip any interaction.
training.completeNote: You have completed the walkthrough. This does not assess fire-safety competence.
training.hint.click: Click the highlighted target or the corresponding part of the model, then select Next.
training.hint.hold: Hold target 3 for one full second using touch, mouse, Space or Enter. Releasing early resets the ring.
training.hint.drag: Move the handle to the highlighted end, then back to the other end. Right and back to left is one cycle. Complete three cycles. You can drag, tap the track, or use the arrow, Home and End keys.
training.success: Interaction complete. Use the button below to continue.
training.skipped: Interaction skipped. Use the button below to continue.
training.storageError: Training is complete, but this browser could not save the completion status.
training.viewer: PASS training model. Drag outside the numbered target to orbit; scroll or pinch to zoom. Use Focus on the part to return to the target.
pass.aim: Aim the nozzle at the base of the fire.
disclaimer: Demo for portfolio purposes. Based on USFA guidance and Permenakertrans PER.04/MEN/1980. Not a substitute for certified fire-safety training.
saved.title: My configurations
saved.name: Configuration name
saved.nameHint: Enter a name of up to 60 characters. Matching names create separate saves.
saved.full: You have 10 saved configurations. Saving will replace the oldest: “{name}”. Cancel to keep all saves.
saved.nameInvalid: Enter a name of 1 to 60 characters, excluding spaces at the start and end.
saved.changed: Saved configurations have changed. Review the details and confirm again.
saved.invalid: Saved data is damaged or uses an unsupported format. It has been kept unchanged. Saving is paused; you can still configure the APAR.
saved.unavailable: Saving is not available in this browser. Check site storage permissions or free space and try again. You can still configure the APAR.
quiz.choiceHint: Choose one answer. Your first answer is final.
quiz.pickHint: Choose a numbered pin in 3D. Drag to rotate, or reset the view. If the panel covers the model, collapse it. Your first answer is final.
quiz.viewer: Fire extinguisher quiz. Use the numbered pins to answer, or drag to rotate.
quiz.saveFailed: Your result could not be saved in this browser.
